title: Refund Policy
text: Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within five business days. Annual plans are prorated after the first 30 days.

title: Shipping Policy
text: Standard domestic shipping takes three to five business days. Express shipping takes one to two business days. Orders over 50 dollars qualify for free standard shipping.

title: Security Overview
text: Customer data is encrypted in transit with TLS and at rest with AES-256. Access is limited by role based access controls and audit logs are retained for one year.

title: Privacy Policy
text: We collect account contact details and product usage events to operate the service. Customers can request deletion of personal data through support.

title: Support Service Level
text: Email support is available Monday through Friday. Enterprise customers receive a four hour initial response target and standard customers receive a two business day target.

title: Billing Guide
text: Subscriptions renew automatically on the billing anniversary. Customers can cancel from account settings; service remains active until the end of the paid period.

title: Availability
text: The service has a 99.9 percent monthly uptime objective. Scheduled maintenance is announced at least 72 hours in advance.

title: API Guide
text: API requests require a bearer token. The default rate limit is 100 requests per minute per workspace. Exceeding it returns HTTP 429.
